name: Numerical Gradient Eikonal Loss
definition: A method to compute surface normals for SDFs using numerical gradients to overcome the locality of analytical gradients in hash encoding, allowing back-propagation updates to propagate to non-local hash grid cells.
summary: Numerical Gradient Eikonal Loss enforces the eikonal equation via finite differences, distributing optimization updates beyond local hash grid cells to ensure non-local smoothness and consistent surface reconstruction.
